road_link_baseline: If sample_count is under 3, it's not reliable yet and isn't used in the live service — the threshold is at least 3 weeks of observations.
avg_volume just stores the raw API value and isn't currently used in congestion calculations.
road_link_traffic_cache: Exactly 1 row per link — overwritten hourly with the latest value, so past values aren't kept.
observed_at is the timestamp from the API; fetched_at is when we actually called it. A few minutes' difference is normal.
road_link_traffic_history: Only the last 48 hours are kept; older rows are auto-deleted every collection cycle.
This is the raw data behind the "today's actual congestion" chart.
holiday_cache: Based on official public holidays, so substitute holidays get their own row too (e.g. "Substitute Holiday (Liberation Day)").
Weekday holidays are treated as Sunday (dow=6) pattern when computing baselines.
district_visitor_baseline: Day of week (dow) uses the same encoding as the road baseline (0=Mon ... 6=Sun).
visitor_ratio of 1.0 = a typical day for that district's average; 1.5 means 50% busier than usual for that day of week.
Only used as a temporary stand-in while the road baseline hasn't accumulated 3 weeks of data yet.
weather_cache: Grid X/Y (nx, ny) are KMA's own grid coordinates, not latitude/longitude.
Precipitation probability is normally empty since the ultra-short-term forecast API doesn't provide this value — that's expected.
uv_index_cache: Area code (area_no) currently only uses a fixed value of '2600000000' (all of Busan).
air_quality_cache: Grades (pm10_grade/pm25_grade) follow the Ministry of Environment's official 4-tier scale — 1=good, 2=moderate, 3=bad, 4=very bad.
rip_current_cache: Risk level increases in severity: low < caution < alert < danger.
This API only returns values during beach season (Jun-Sep), so an empty table off-season is expected.
